summary: WMT has reported. There is an 8-K 2.02/9.01 filed today and a 12:31Z headline, 'Walmart Raises Fiscal Year Guidance Amid 3Q Earnings Beat'. That confirms yesterday's inference that the 11-17 'Reports Q3' item was a preview, and it means guidance went up, not down. The stock's reaction is not in my input. The only names with high event risk for a new buy are ADSK and BBY: both estimated 11-24, 3 trading days out, and neither is held. BLBD drops out of the window because the company now says it reports 12-02, so the 11-23 file estimate I flagged high on 11-17 and 11-18 was stale. The rest of the tape is quiet. No 4.01 or 4.02 appears anywhere. No held name other than WMT has a new filing. The crypto, ETF and rates sleeves have had no tagged item for a third day.

Held. Q3 results are out today, with an 8-K 2.02/9.01 filed 11-19 and the 'Raises Fiscal Year Guidance Amid 3Q Earnings Beat' headline at 12:31Z, before the open. The event has happened, so the gap lands at today's open before any close-based stop can act (L7). I can't see the price reaction. The guidance clause in the thesis is not tripped, because guidance was raised. The 11-16 8-K 5.02 matched the Joe Creed board appointment on 11-17 (inference). Next earnings date is unverified: the file's estimate is still today's date and the input has nothing newer. Last year's pattern would put it around mid-to-late February 2027, but that is a guess, not a date. Today's Happy Cappy and Fly By Jing shelf items are noise.

The 8-K 5.02 filed 11-12 is still unread, with no headline, and it ages out of the 7-day window after today. Treat it as an unexplained officer change until it is read. Check the filing before any FTDR proposal. Next 2027-02-25 (file estimate). Not known to be held.

Raised from low. On 11-18 the shares fell on reports of possible changes to Medicare Advantage reimbursement rates. That is a regulatory risk to the business, more concrete than Senator Warren's same-day breakup call, though no agency rule or date is named. It continues the negative drift since 11-10: four sell-side cuts, then Warren, now this. Next 2027-02-09 (file estimate). Not known to be held.

The 11-16 5.02 was Zach Davis's promotion to President and CFO. RBC raised its PT to $373 from $319 (Outperform) today, which suggests the street is not reading the filing as a negative. Next 2027-02-25. Not known to be held.

notable.headline: Walmart Raises Fiscal Year Guidance Amid 3Q Earnings Beat (11-19 12:31Z; 8-K 2.02/9.01 filed 11-19)
notable.read: This closes the pre-print thread from 11-10 to 11-18. The 8-K 2.02 is dated today, so yesterday's reading of the 11-17 'Reports Q3' headline as a mis-summarized preview held. That reading was an inference, and the filing now confirms it. Guidance was raised, so WMT's 'guidance cut' invalidation clause is not met. With about eleven PT raises before the print the bar was high, and 'beat and raise' does not by itself tell us how the stock trades on it. The PM should read the reaction from the marks, not from this headline. Next earnings date is unverified (the file still shows today).

notable.headline: Blue Bird Corporation to Report Fiscal 2026 Fourth Quarter and Full Year Results on December 2, 2026 (11-18)
notable.read: The company date replaces the stale 11-23 file estimate. My high flags on 11-17 and 11-18 rested on that estimate, so they were flags on the wrong date. This is the same failure mode L2 warns about, now coming from the estimate side rather than from missing data. The 12-02 date is 8 trading days out and enters the 5-day window around 11-24.

notable.headline: CVS Health Shares Decline Amid Reports of Potential Medicare Advantage Reimbursement Changes (11-18)
notable.read: This is the first regulatory item on reimbursement, not just analysts or politicians. It continues the drift since 11-10 (four sell-side cuts, then Warren's breakup call the same morning). It is a report with no rule or date, but it goes to the economics of the insurance arm. Not held.

notable.read: A second insider sale in two days on a held name ($1.29M on 11-17). Both are small and the plan status is unknown. Taken together they are a mild sentiment negative after the 11-13 MAESTRA-3 drop. They do not touch guidance or any measurable thesis clause.

notable.read: A large target raise two days after the unexplained 8-K 1.01/2.03. It suggests the street does not read that filing as a negative, which supports the financing inference without proving it. Not known to be held.
